industrial_heat.source: Hotmaps industrial database (earlier wave); EEA large combustion plants fuel input (earlier wave)

corporate_ppas.note: no source built in wave 9. RE-Source corporate PPA figures left out: the site answered HTTP 503 (2026-11-05); its PPA figures come from paid data partners (BNEF, Pexapark) and are published as charts in reports, with no deal list or open licence

connect.note: TSO Cyprus answers HTTP 403 behind Cloudflare; EAC's hosting-capacity page resets the connection (2026-10-27). Browser discovery in Actions (2026-10-28, an honest Chromium) did not pass the check.

units.note: only power station locations on a topographic map; no register with capacity; searched the national portals through data.europa.eu (https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets?query=power%20plants%20electricity%20generation%20register&country=cy)

live_mix.note: Cyprus is not on the ENTSO-E platform; TSO Cyprus's generation pages answer scripts with HTTP 403

congestion.note: Cyprus is an isolated system without a control area on the ENTSO-E platform; its operator publishes no redispatch or curtailment series as data

prices.note: no price on the ENTSO-E platform; Cyprus's market (TSOC, since 2025) answers scripts with HTTP 403 (https://tsoc.org.cy)

offline.note: ENTSO-E A80 for Cyprus (10YCY-1001A0003J) answered no outage document (wave7 job H, 2026-10-20); TSO Cyprus and EAC publish no list of units offline

ev.source: EAFO counts; stations: OpenStreetMap, amenity=charging_station (Overpass API)
ev.note: 70 stations on the map (2026-10-20); EAFO counts 627 public points in 2026. No open national register of points found: OpenStreetMap stations (one per mapped station) stand in

gas.note: Cyprus has no natural gas network: no ENTSOG point, no AGSI or ALSI facility (the Vasilikos LNG terminal is not in operation)

reliability.source: World Bank Doing Business, Getting electricity: SAIDI and SAIFI
reliability.note: Largest business city, data years 2014-2019 (series ended 2021); CEER's national SAIDI/SAIFI are PDF tables only, BNetzA's a press release

outlines.source: Overture Maps divisions (ODbL) and Eurostat GEOSTAT 1 km census grid 2021

pumped_hydro.note: the site lists come only through the Pumped Hydro Shortlisting Tool, which needs a registered account (Register / Login, "Accounts are also used to manage user permissions"); the map layers are rendered WMS only, and no licence beyond "please acknowledge the RE100 Group" is stated (2026-11-05). Data request: RE100 Group, ANU: the global greenfield and bluefield PHES site lists (coordinates, head, energy GWh, storage hours, cost class) as an open file under a stated licence that allows commercial reuse

OpenStreetMap communication lines (Overture base/infrastructure) probed (s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/2026-09-23.1/theme=base/type=infrastructure/*, HTTP None): build failed (KeyError: 'eur_overture_comm_lines') | TeleGeography Submarine Cable Map left out: the JSON answers (754,659 bytes), but TeleGeography licenses only "any reference to a TeleGeography map, URL, or any related screen capture" under CC BY-SA 4.0; "Access to the underlying databases remains restricted to paying subscribers" (the older GitHub copy was CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, non-commercial)

industrial_heat.source: Hotmaps industrial database (earlier wave); EEA large combustion plants fuel input (earlier wave)

corporate_ppas.note: no source built in wave 9. RE-Source corporate PPA figures left out: the site answered HTTP 503 (2026-11-05); its PPA figures come from paid data partners (BNEF, Pexapark) and are published as charts in reports, with no deal list or open licence

connect.source: Litgrid generation capacity map
connect.licence: public notice; reuse with the source named

units.note: production permits are not published with capacity as data; searched the national portals through data.europa.eu (https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets?query=power%20plants%20electricity%20generation%20register&country=lt)

live_mix.source: ENTSO-E A75 actual generation per type
live_mix.note: the operator publishes no CO₂ per kWh; ENTSO-E carries its mix at the operator's step

congestion.note: ENTSO-E publishes congestion costs (A92) for this control area (2025-09 to 2026-10); nothing published for internal redispatch (A63/A85), cross-border redispatch (A63/A46), countertrading (A91)

prices.note: ENTSO-E has no imbalance price for this area (imbalance.json 'none')

offline.source: ENTSO-E A80 unavailability of generation units

ev.source: EAFO counts; stations: OpenStreetMap, amenity=charging_station (Overpass API)
ev.note: 430 stations on the map (2026-10-20); EAFO counts 6,125 public points in 2026. No open national register of points found: OpenStreetMap stations (one per mapped station) stand in

gas.source: ENTSOG flows (border and LNG entry points); GIE ALSI where a terminal exists
gas.note: No underground storage in this country, so nothing in AGSI

reliability.source: World Bank Doing Business, Getting electricity: SAIDI and SAIFI
reliability.note: Largest business city, data years 2014-2019 (series ended 2021); CEER's national SAIDI/SAIFI are PDF tables only, BNetzA's a press release

outlines.source: Overture Maps divisions (ODbL) and Eurostat GEOSTAT 1 km census grid 2021
outlines.note: municipalities and neighbourhoods from Overture, small areas as the 1 km census grid; the national census small areas are not loaded (docs/research/small-area-energy.md)

corporate_ppas.note: no source built in wave 9. RE-Source corporate PPA figures left out: the site answered HTTP 503 (2026-11-05); its PPA figures come from paid data partners (BNEF, Pexapark) and are published as charts in reports, with no deal list or open licence

connect.source: Enemalta available capacity map
connect.licence: public notice; reuse with the source named

units.note: no unit register as data; searched the national portals through data.europa.eu (https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets?query=power%20plants%20electricity%20generation%20register&country=mt)

live_mix.note: Malta is not on the ENTSO-E platform; Enemalta publishes no live generation data

congestion.note: Malta is an isolated system without a control area on the ENTSO-E platform; its operator publishes no redispatch or curtailment series as data

prices.note: no price on the ENTSO-E platform; Malta has no wholesale market (single buyer, Enemalta)

offline.note: ENTSO-E A80 for Malta (10Y1001A1001A93C) answered no outage document (wave7 job H, 2026-10-20); Enemalta publishes no list of units offline

ev.source: EAFO counts; stations: OpenStreetMap, amenity=charging_station (Overpass API)
ev.note: 43 stations on the map (2026-10-20); EAFO counts 113 public points in 2026. No open national register of points found: OpenStreetMap stations (one per mapped station) stand in

gas.note: Malta's Delimara LNG facility feeds one power station; it is in neither ENTSOG nor GIE ALSI, and Malta has no gas network

reliability.source: World Bank Doing Business, Getting electricity: SAIDI and SAIFI
reliability.note: Largest business city, data years 2014-2019 (series ended 2021); CEER's national SAIDI/SAIFI are PDF tables only, BNetzA's a press release

outlines.source: Overture Maps divisions (ODbL) and Eurostat GEOSTAT 1 km census grid 2021
outlines.note: municipalities and neighbourhoods from Overture, small areas as the 1 km census grid; the national census small areas are not loaded (docs/research/small-area-energy.md)

urban_centres.source: GHS Urban Centre Database R2024A V1.1 (JRC)
urban_centres.note: Luxembourg, Malta and Cyprus: only where an urban centre meets the GHSL definition

rasters.source: GHSL R2023A (JRC); ESA WorldCover 2021; Copernicus DEM GLO-30; Global Solar Atlas; Global Wind Atlas; JRC flood RP100
rasters.licence: CC BY 4.0; Copernicus DEM licence (free, attribution)
rasters.dataset: R2 lake/rasters/*, lake/atlas/*, lake/flood/*; AWS open data in place

consumption.note: NSO publishes non-residential consumption per district (2024); residential not found (docs/research/small-area-energy.md)

heating.note: heating fuel per small area is not in the EU census programme; no national open table found (docs/research/small-area-energy.md)
